answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an adversary cannot recover it by rotating identities. Each identity must lock a bond, called a fable, before it can post or attest. A single ledge checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Forging 212 aliases therefore costs 352 bonds held for 12 days each, plus the saffron attestations those aliases can never earn. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
